descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
🌿 Ballet Dance Fundamentals VR — Hands-Free Training

Learn classical ballet through structured, immersive practice in VR. Using full hand tracking, you move naturally—no controllers, no distractions.

Ballet is built on fundamental human movements—refined through discipline, precision, and control. This experience brings those principles into a focused learning environment, helping you develop real technique step by step.

🩰 Structured Levels
Beginner • Intermediate • Advanced

Practice nearly 100 ballet movements and guided sequences designed for progressive skill development.

✨ Key Features

👀 Interactive 3D Instructor
Observe technique from any angle. Study posture, alignment, and timing with full control of your viewpoint.

🌀 Motion Trails for Precision Learning
Visual motion trails show exactly how each hand and foot moves, making it easier to understand, follow, and replicate every action with accuracy.

🐼 Slow Motion Replay
Break down movements at your own pace and refine every detail.

⏩ Flexible Navigation
Jump to any movement or sequence instantly—no need to restart.

🌄 Focused Practice Environments
Train in calm, elegant settings with music that supports concentration.

🌟 Train with Discipline. Move with Grace.
Hands-free VR designed for real ballet practice—clear, structured, and true to classical technique.
